items.name: Default
items.summary: Basic sparkline from numeric array values. Use as a compact trend indicator.

items.name: Marks
items.summary: Mark variants include line, area, gradient, column, and winloss to support trend and outcome signals.

items.name: Status
items.summary: Semantic statuses apply task, support, and trend color mappings.

items.name: InlineWithText

items.summary: Sparklines inherit font size and flow inline with surrounding text and metrics.

items.name: DataGrid
items.template:
<nve-grid>
  <nve-grid-header>
    <nve-grid-column>Autonomy Service</nve-grid-column>
    <nve-grid-column>Safety Score</nve-grid-column>
    <nve-grid-column>Interventions / Shift</nve-grid-column>
    <nve-grid-column>Route Outcome</nve-grid-column>
  </nve-grid-header>
  <nve-grid-row>
    <nve-grid-cell>Lane Keeping</nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Lane Keeping 30 day safety score trend" mark="area" status="success" min="0" max="100" data="[86, 87, 86, 88, 89, 90, 92, 93]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Lane Keeping interventions per shift" mark="column" status="success" min="0" max="50" data="[12, 11, 12, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Lane Keeping route outcomes" mark="winloss" data="[1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
  </nve-grid-row>
  <nve-grid-row>
    <nve-grid-cell>Object Detection</nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Object Detection 30 day safety score trend" mark="area" status="warning" min="0" max="100" data="[76, 88, 72, 79, 85, 70, 83, 74]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Object Detection interventions per shift" mark="column" status="warning" min="0" max="50" data="[18, 20, 17, 19, 20, 21, 19, 22]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Object Detection route outcomes" mark="winloss" data="[1, 0, -1, 1, 0, -1, 0, 1]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
  </nve-grid-row>
  <nve-grid-row>
    <nve-grid-cell>Path Planning</nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Path Planning 30 day safety score trend" mark="area" status="danger" min="0" max="100" data="[58, 54, 49, 45, 40, 36, 31, 27]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Path Planning interventions per shift" mark="column" status="danger" min="0" max="50" data="[24, 26, 29, 31, 34, 36, 39, 42]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
    <nve-grid-cell>
      <nve-sparkline aria-label="Path Planning route outcomes" mark="winloss" data="[1, -1, 0, -1, -1, -1, 0, -1]" size="md"></nve-sparkline>
    </nve-grid-cell>
  </nve-grid-row>
</nve-grid>
items.summary: Embed sparklines in grid cells to add compact trend context to tabular data.

items.name: ExplicitSize
items.summary: Explicit size tokens set fixed sparkline height independent of text context.

items.name: DefaultSize
items.template:
heading
body
label sm
items.summary: Without a size attribute, height scales with the parent text size for typographic alignment.

items.name: Interpolation
items.summary: Interpolation controls linear, smooth, or step transitions between points.

items.name: Symbols
items.summary: Symbols denote specific data points in line, area, and gradient marks.

items.name: FixedDataDomain
items.summary: Fixed min and max values define a shared vertical domain to ensure comparability across adjacent sparklines.

items.name: ZeroLine
items.summary: The chart renders a zero baseline when the data includes both positive and negative values.

items.name: IntervalLength
items.summary: Interval length adjusts spacing between points for line marks, from compact to spacious.

items.name: CustomStyling
items.template:
<nve-sparkline
  aria-label="custom sparkline"
  mark="gradient"
  interpolation="smooth"
  data="[8, 14, 9, 17, 13, 21, 16]"
  denote-last
  style="
    --height: 120px;
    --accent-color: var(--nve-sys-layer-canvas-background);
    --accent-radius: 5px;
    --accent-border-width: 3px;
    --line-width: 2.5px;
    --line-color: var(--nve-ref-color-blue-cobalt-1100);
    --gradient-max-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--nve-ref-color-blue-cobalt-1100) 45%, transparent);
    --gradient-min-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--nve-ref-color-blue-cobalt-1100), transparent 90%);
  "
></nve-sparkline>
items.summary: CSS custom properties are available to adjust dimensions and visual styling.
